decision: Use the checkpoint author's exact recommended stock runtime version to distinguish a faulty public AWQ checkpoint from faulty custom SGLang loader semantics.

causal_hypothesis.primary: If the public AWQ checkpoint is semantically sound, stock vLLM 0.15.0 will load it on one L40S and return the requested JSON deterministically; a pass attributes v15's gibberish to the custom SGLang loader path, while repeated invalid output rejects the checkpoint lineage.
causal_hypothesis.stock_control: V15 used the same checkpoint and L40S class with the four-part custom SGLang patch. It reached health but two identical temperature-zero requests returned different repetitive gibberish.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: Uncertain: vLLM either returns exact semantic JSON twice or reproduces invalid output, cleanly disambiguating runtime versus checkpoint.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A vLLM load failure or invalid output prevents any claim that the author-recommended path works on this geometry; a correct output falsifies the custom SGLang patch semantics.

changed_from_v15.candidate_change: replace patched SGLang 0.5.15 with unmodified author-recommended vLLM 0.15.0 amd64 image; no speculative MTP
changed_from_v15.unchanged: exact checkpoint bytes, local/remote hash gates, L40S class, preemptible policy, host RAM, disk, context, temperature, seed, two-request semantic/determinism gate, telemetry, budget, artifacts, and cleanup
changed_from_v15.repeat_classification: materially different serving runtime and loader implementation; not an unchanged semantic retry

workload_geometry.request: two sequential identical prompts requiring exactly the JSON object {alpha:17,beta:smoke}

quality_gate.determinism: normalized content/reasoning/tool-call structures must match exactly
quality_gate.semantic: both contents must parse as JSON after optional Markdown fence removal and equal {"alpha":17,"beta":"smoke"}
quality_gate.claim_limit: pass proves only this stock vLLM semantic smoke; no quality parity or cost claim

service_contract.preemption: provider stop is infrastructure failure only

predictions.semantic_json: approximately 50% pass probability conditional on load
predictions.business: no cost claim; only a correct stock control can reopen the AWQ performance branch

budget.limitations: public IPv4 and egress excluded; invoice pending

artifact_contract.cleanup: retrieve and hash before deletion; verify instance GET not-found and zero named instances/disks

falsification_rules.delivery: Any hash/count/byte mismatch stops before load.
falsification_rules.runtime: Load failure rejects this author-recommended runtime/device geometry.
falsification_rules.semantics: Any HTTP failure, nondeterminism, non-JSON, or wrong object fails the control.
falsification_rules.lineage: If vLLM also fails semantics, stop the public AWQ checkpoint lineage; if it passes, stop the custom SGLang patch lineage and only then consider vLLM performance.
falsification_rules.repeat: Do not repeat an identical failure.
falsification_rules.business: No quality parity, throughput, dollar-per-token, or provider claim from this smoke.
